objects.name: ix_reqkey_created
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX ix_reqkey_created
    ON spawn_instance (request_key, created_at DESC)
    WHERE request_key IS NOT NULL

objects.name: ix_requester_created
objects.sql:
CREATE INDEX ix_requester_created
    ON spawn_instance (requester, created_at DESC)

objects.name: migrations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE migrations (
                    filename TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    applied_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
                )

objects.name: runner_entry
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE runner_entry (
    id         TEXT      NOT NULL,
    label      TEXT      NOT NULL,
    cmd        TEXT      NOT NULL,
    cwd        TEXT,
    env        TEXT      NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_runner_entry     PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT ck_runner_cmd_len   CHECK (length(cmd) BETWEEN 1 AND 4096),
    CONSTRAINT ck_runner_label_len CHECK (length(label) <= 128)
)

objects.name: spawn_daily_seq
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE spawn_daily_seq (
    date_part  TEXT      NOT NULL,
    last_seq   INTEGER   NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_spawn_daily_seq  PRIMARY KEY (date_part),
    CONSTRAINT ck_last_seq_nonneg  CHECK (last_seq >= 0)
)

objects.name: spawn_instance
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "spawn_instance" (
    id           TEXT      NOT NULL,
    requester    TEXT      NOT NULL,
    kind         TEXT      NOT NULL,
    status       TEXT      NOT NULL DEFAULT 'created',
    request_key  TEXT,
    label        TEXT,
    ttl_seconds  INTEGER   NOT NULL DEFAULT 3600,
    created_at   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    expires_at   TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT pk_spawn_instance PRIMARY KEY (id),
    CONSTRAINT ck_kind          CHECK (kind IN ('session', 'worker', 'task')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_status        CHECK (status IN ('created', 'active', 'expired')),
    CONSTRAINT ck_ttl_range     CHECK (ttl_seconds BETWEEN 60 AND 86400),
    CONSTRAINT ck_requester_len CHECK (length(requester) <= 64),
    CONSTRAINT ck_kind_len      CHECK (length(kind) <= 32),
    CONSTRAINT ck_label_len     CHECK (label IS NULL OR length(label) <= 256),
    CONSTRAINT ck_expires_after CHECK (expires_at > created_at)
)
